issues.explanation: Chapter 100 ends by saying孔明率军“返回成都”, but Chapter 101 then has him first退回汉中 and subsequently回成都见后主. This makes the opening of Chapter 101 a backward timeline reset and repeats the Chengdu arrival. The source chapters place him at汉中 before his Cheng都 audience.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the ending of Chapter 100 to say孔明退往汉中 (or退回汉中，随后再回成都), leaving his arrival in成都 and audience with后主 for Chapter 101.
